name: immersive-sales-room
description: A 3D sales dashboard you walk through, built as a Fabric App with Rayfin: a lobby, a sales room with KPI cards, a store map and a decomposition tree down to a single product, driven by DAX measures on a Fabric semantic model or by bundled sample data.
author: Gregory Moureau (illustrated.be)

template.name: universal-app
template.description: A lean React + Vite starter that grows into anything. A built-in capability router reads what you ask for, then enables the right Rayfin services, installs the right modules, and activates the right skills — CRUD apps, functions, charts, or Fabric analytics dashboards.

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
